note: FNS 726.1 describes a QC reviewer methodology for determining whether income variances in simplified reporting households constitute errors. The three-step process (Comparison I allotment test, Comparison II against 130% FPL reporting threshold, Step 3 agency-had-time-to-act determination) is a QC audit procedure, not a caseworker policy rule. The underlying SNAP policy rules embedded in this section — that simplified reporting households must report when gross income exceeds 130% FPL for their household size, and that the agency must act on reported changes — ARE covered in the OLG across multiple pages: 'Simplified Reporting – Reporting Requirements During Case Maintenance' (gross income limit reporting requirement), 'Simplified Reporting – Overview' (only required to report if monthly gross income exceeds the limit), and 'Simplified Reporting – Examples' (Q&A on when income changes must be reported). The OLG appropriately translates these rules into worker-actionable guidance without replicating the QC variance determination framework, which is used by auditors evaluating case accuracy after the fact, not by eligibility workers processing cases.
